Subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Leah / Acme procurement team,

Following our conversation during the security review, we're sending a compact request for the SOC 2 Type II materials needed to complete your diligence. To move quickly, can you confirm the audit period you expect and whether a bridge letter is acceptable in addition to the full report? Typical asks from customers are: 1) a copy of the Type II report (redacted as needed), 2) a bridge letter covering the gap between the report date and today, and 3) a short evidence manifest or sample artifacts.

Questions for you:
- Audit period preference (e.g., 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31)
- Do you require an unredacted report or will redacted versions suffice?
- Preferred transfer method: S3 presigned, secure Drive link, or portal upload?

Attachments: sample bridge-letter template (PDF) and a one-page note with transfer options. We'll also share an executed NDA if needed.

Next steps proposed: once you confirm period and transfer method, Hannah will coordinate secure delivery and any short reply templates your procurement team prefers for internal signoff.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben — thanks for the clear note. A few quick items from our side:

1) Audit period: procurement would prefer coverage that includes all of 2027 (2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31). If your latest Type II report has a different period, a bridge letter that explicitly states coverage from the end of the last report to our contract signing date should work.
2) Redaction: we can accept redacted reports for commercial terms and low-level usernames; auditor attestations and control descriptions should remain intact.
3) Transfer: S3 presigned or a secure Drive link are both acceptable. Our procurement team will mark files as confidential.

One more ask — can you share an NDA if you need additional evidence that is not already listed in the report? If you have a standard bridge-letter wording we can review, please include it.

Leah Porter
Head of Security, Acme Corp
